testResults.name: streaming-run-recorder
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/results/test_recorder.py -q
testResults.result: 27 tests passed: a scripted run produces every required artifact with complete action-to-order-to-fill links, and a one-million-event stream stays memory bounded (pending rows capped at the batch size, ~10k) while writing exactly 1,000,000 rows.

testResults.name: determinism
testResults.result: Repeated identical scripted runs produce byte-identical artifacts including the manifest; execution_reports round-trips through the core ParquetCodec.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; the recorder implements the strategy Emitter protocol directly, uses EngineIdSource identity and injected clocks, and has no wall-clock, random, or network dependency.

decisions: Eleven linked Parquet artifacts (actions, orders, risk_decisions, risk_audits, fills, execution_reports, position_transitions, equity, emissions, markers, events) stream one row group per batch for bounded memory.
The recorder is a submodule package behind the unchanged harness.results.recorder import surface; schemas extend core ORDER/FILL/REPORT schemas for referential integrity.
